name: Jimmy Bogroff

bio.statement: Bogroff's pamphlet statement lists his occupation as founder of Fearless Influence, a marketing agency.
bio.excerpt: Founder, Fearless Influence, a marketing agency

bio.statement: Bogroff's pamphlet statement lists prior work as director of digital strategy at Oregonian Media Group.
bio.excerpt: Director, Digital Strategy, Oregonian Media Group.

bio.statement: Bogroff's pamphlet statement lists bachelor's degrees in economics and history from Willamette University.
bio.excerpt: Willamette University, Bachelor’s degrees in Economics and History, 1999.

bio.statement: Bogroff's pamphlet statement lists service on the City of Banks Planning Commission since 2025.

positions.statement: In his voters' pamphlet statement, Bogroff says he would increase volunteers and fill all open seats on city committees.
positions.excerpt: Increase volunteers and fill 100% of our open seats on city committees

positions.statement: Bogroff's pamphlet statement calls for planning the city's future on zoning, historic inventory and shared spaces.
positions.excerpt: Plan our future proactively and together: zoning, historic inventory, and shared spaces

positions.statement: Bogroff's campaign site says he is committed to small businesses and keeping local dollars local.
positions.excerpt: I am committed to our small businesses, and to keeping local dollars local.

positions.statement: Bogroff's campaign site says growth does not have to cost Banks its identity.
positions.excerpt: Growth does not have to cost us who we are.

gaps: No press coverage of his positions found; Banks Post filing article has no quotes from him
collection_notes: Banks certification letter PDF returned no machine-readable text, and the city's council roster page (cityofbanks.org/meetmayor-council) blocks automated fetch. Incumbency is taken from the City of Banks council minutes of Feb. 11, 2025 (T1), which list Mayor Marsha Kirk and Councilors Peter Edison, Don Giannetti, Marilyn McCalister, Niki Walters, Pearcia Bogroff and Stephanie Jones. Banks Post (bankspost.com, bylined local newspaper by Chas Hundley) is treated as T3. Step 5 searches found no coverage of Banks candidates in the fixed outlet groups. Feb. 2025 minutes show Marsha Kirk as mayor, so Bogroff is not the incumbent. Campaign domain printed in his pamphlet statement.
